purpose: Correct the collision representation before extending mechanism claims. FM06-R1 design geometry is unchanged.
mandatory_checks: Exact CAD union equivalence and disjoint convex payload cells; no filled panel recess.

Reproduce FCE08 transformed-solid intersections with both collision representations; require detection for deliberate 0.1/0.5/1mm slab overlaps and no false negative or positive in separated controls.
Native source, geometry, solver, input and raw output identities.
Independent transformed B-rep checks across transfer and withdrawal, including the previous failure times.
Timestep/iteration/surface refinement of displacement, angular motion, impulse and integrated work; do not rate an impulsive NSC force peak.
Fault cases are distinct from nominal convergence and do not demonstrate physical safe-state reliability.
targets_basis: Provisional numerical model screening thresholds. 25um is half the smallest 50um nominal guide-side clearance; these are not customer delivery requirements, measured contact compliance, process capability or flight acceptance. Positive B-rep intersections must still be reported; screen acceptance cannot be relabeled zero interference.
scope: Transfer/capture/withdraw subcycle only. Full release/reset, installed actuation and physical calibration remain separate requirements.
